goal: 理解 agent 与 chatbot 的本质区别, 并能判断一个给定系统是不是 agent

ideal_lesson_body.thesis: By the end of this lesson, the learner will see that an agent is a chatbot plus a closed feedback loop with real-world side effects.
ideal_lesson_body.canonical_example: 2023 Princeton ReAct (Yao et al.) — single model alternates 'Thought' / 'Action' / 'Observation' on HotpotQA; without the Observation step it degrades to chatbot.
common_misconceptions: Agent = chatbot with system prompt. 错: 缺少 action + observation 循环就只是 wrapper.
Agent = 多个 model 串联. 错: 串联但无环境反馈仍是 pipeline 不是 agent.
ideal_lesson_body.exit_proof: 给出 3 个真实系统 (Bing Chat / Devin / ChatGPT Code Interpreter), 学习者判定每个是不是 agent 并说明判据.
ideal_lesson_body.mechanism_explanation: Agent 的最小循环 = perceive → think → act → observe → update. 像盲人摸象, 每次 action 后必须摸一下环境才下一步; 失去 observe 等于断手.
jargon_list: ReAct — 让 model 交替 Thought 和 Action 的提示模式
tool-use — model 调外部 API 取信息 / 改世界
observation — action 执行完真世界回的信号
ideal_lesson_body.note_connection: (first lesson — no prior note to bind to)
ideal_lesson_body.learn_goal: 理解 agent 与 chatbot 的本质区别, 并能判断一个给定系统是不是 agent
ideal_lesson_body.intro_hook_scene: 2023 年 3 月, AutoGPT 第一次能自己开浏览器订机票 — 但 60% 任务它点错按钮后不知道自己点错了.

notes: Golden because: thesis 一句话区分 agent vs chatbot (反 encyclopedia framing); canonical_example 命名 ReAct + 年份 + 论文; misconception 两条都是真正高发先验; exit_proof 用 3 个真实系统 force 判定 (非 recall).
